fusions.name: Shoulder Through
fusions.desc: Barges around you and deals 4 blunt damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Bull Rush
fusions.desc: Charges an enemy up to 7 tiles away and deals 26 blunt damage, rising to double that at 7 tiles, plus 5% of its maximum health if it is a boss or elite.

fusions.name: Shared Heat
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Well Fed
fusions.desc: While you are at full health, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 8 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
